metadata.status_scope: The audited management report separately names Data Centers E and F and explicitly says construction of both began during 2025. Each sibling source therefore receives its own generic under_construction observation as of the December 31, 2025 balance-sheet date. The statement does not establish an exact start date or a finer clearing, civil, foundations, shell, MEP, energization, or commissioning stage.
metadata.phase_identity_scope: Data Center E and Data Center F are preserved as distinct project identities under one Falun campus. They are not collapsed into an E/F aggregate project, treated as interchangeable phases, or counted as separate campuses.
metadata.capacity_guardrail: The report labels 41 MW and 65 MW only as total Falun capacity. Their 24 MW arithmetic difference is an analyst-computed combined E-and-F delta, not a source-typed critical IT, gross facility, grid connection, generation, current draw, or annual-energy value. It remains metadata only, is represented no more than once per source record, and is not split, divided, duplicated, or allocated to either project.

metadata.data_center_e_forecast_as_reported: expected to be operational at the end of Q4 2026
metadata.forecast_guardrail: The E and F operating windows are forward-looking forecasts. They create no target date, completion, commissioning, operation, occupancy, utilization, present-day status, or current-load assertion.
metadata.role_scope: The report says EcoDataCenter designs, builds, and operates data centers and identifies EcoDC Falun AB as the subsidiary operating data-center operations at the Falun site. This supports EcoDataCenter as developer and intended operator for the campus and both unfinished projects, but not Areim as site owner or any additional role.
metadata.locality_scope: The management report explicitly locates Data Centers E and F at the Falun site. The parent company's Slaggvarpsvägen head-office address is not treated as proof of the physical data-center address. This record retains only Falun, Sweden and creates no street address, postal code, parcel, point, footprint, coordinates, geometry, or unique-site assertion.

metadata.classification_guardrail: General AI demand, customer selection, service, and digital-infrastructure language is not specific to Data Center E or F and creates no workload, tenant, customer, user, installed-hardware, accelerator, server, model, operating-model, or occupancy observation.
